back_translation: Behold, the hand of the LORD is not too short to save, nor is his ear too dull to hear.
But your iniquities have separated you from your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so he does not hear.
For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.
No one brings suit righteously; no one pleads a case in good faith. They rely on empty excuses and speak falsehood; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.
They hatch vipers' eggs and weave a spider's web; whoever eats their eggs dies, and the egg that is crushed hatches out a venomous snake.
Their webs cannot become clothing; they cannot cover themselves with their own works. Their works are works of evil, and acts of violence are in their hands.
Their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are wicked thoughts; ruin and misery are in their highways.
The way of peace they have never known, and there is no justice in their paths. They have made their roads crooked; whoever walks in them will not know peace.
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not catch up with us. We hope for light, but behold, only darkness; for brightness, but we walk in deep gloom.
We grope along the wall like the blind; we feel our way like those without eyes. We stumble at noon as in the twilight; among the strong we are like the dead.
We all growl like bears and moan mournfully like doves. We hope for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far from us.
For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are with us always, and we know our iniquities:
rebelling and denying the LORD, turning back from following our God, speaking oppression and betrayal, conceiving and muttering lying words from the heart.
Justice is pushed back, and righteousness stands far off; for truth has fallen in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.
Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey. The LORD looked, and the absence of justice was evil in his sight.
He saw that there was no one at all, and was astonished that there was no one to intercede; so his own arm brought salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.
He put on righteousness as a breastplate and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal like a cloak.
He will repay according to their deeds: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies, and repayment to the islands.
So they will fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come like a rushing torrent, driven along by the wind of the LORD.
"The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn back from transgression," declares the LORD.

The LORD says: "As for me, this is my covenant with them: my Spirit who is upon you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, will not depart from your mouth, or from the mouth of your offspring, or from the mouth of your offspring's offspring, from now on and forever," says the LORD.
